title: A Simulation System Towards Solving Societal-Scale Manipulation

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a multi-agent mayoral election within a social media environment (Mastodon) and using longitudinal surveys to track agents' voting preferences and candidate favorability over time. This measures both the inherent left-leaning political bias of the underlying LLM and the impact of simulated partisan biases (seeded voter beliefs) and malicious manipulation on the agent population.
